[LNUL.7.2] **A series aggregation is nullable exactly where it is
undefined.** A cold read ([LSER.19.8]) of a counting, membership, `sum` or
signal aggregation yields its concrete zero; every other aggregation is `T?` and
yields `null` while cold. In a `where` predicate that `null` propagates and the
rule does not fire ([LNUL.4.3]), so a cold read needs no guard there; at a
concrete-value position it is rescued with `??` or written to a `T?` slot
([LNUL.5.1]).

**A series sample is never `null`.** A series over a `T?` source absorbs a
`null` sample by its declared policy ([LNUL.8.6]), so the only `null` an
aggregation yields is the cold one.
